prompts.use: Google Search image asset, square, no overlays
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: premium Google Search image asset, square 1:1 canvas, at least 1200 by 1200 pixels. Primary request: a beautiful premium editorial advertising photograph illustrating online AML/CFT professional training for Les Consultants E-learning in Luxembourg. Subject: a fictional mid-career European business professional with natural features and an emerald green knit jacket, engaged with an online lesson on a slim unbranded laptop in a bright refined contemporary European office. A second colleague is subtly present out of focus, suggesting team learning. Camera: intimate medium shot, candid concentration rather than a posed stock-photo smile, beautifully realistic hands and fabric, calm confidence. Composition: clean and uncluttered; keep face, hands, and laptop inside the central 80 percent for safe cropping. Lighting: soft daylight, warm white and understated shadows. Color palette: rich emerald #157a61, dark green #0f5e4a, ivory #f4f8f6, pale mint #e6f3ef. Laptop screen may show a softly blurred lesson interface with no readable words or invented claims. Constraints: no text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no graphic overlays, no floating UI, no shields or padlock cliches, no recognizable real person. Produce one finished full-bleed photograph, not a collage or a mockup.

prompts.use: Google Search image asset, landscape 1.91:1, no overlays
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: premium Google Search landscape image asset. Exact composition ratio 1.91:1, wide horizontal, intended final size 1200 by 628 pixels or larger with the same ratio. Primary request: sophisticated editorial advertising photography for online AML 2026 training at Les Consultants E-learning Luxembourg. Scene: two fictional financial-sector professionals, a woman and a man in their thirties to forties, seated together at a simple white table, thoughtfully studying an online training module on an unbranded laptop in a sunlit contemporary European office. Natural posture, believable hands, intelligent calm expressions, genuine attention to the laptop. They are not shaking hands or posing for the camera. One wears a muted emerald blazer and the other a light neutral shirt; a single dark green notebook and pen provide brand color. Composition: an elegant wide shot with all essential people and learning details within the central 80 percent, plenty of breathing room, background glass and soft greenery. Lighting: luminous natural window light, cream-white background, very subtle film texture and rich green detail, polished commercial realism. Palette: #157a61, #0f5e4a, #f4f8f6, #e6f3ef. Constraints: absolutely no text or brand logos, no text overlay, no watermark, no collage, no charts with fabricated metrics, no regulatory seal, no neon technology effects, no visible identifiable personal data. Create one finished full-bleed photograph.

prompts.use: Promotional creative with text for Display/social formats; not a Search image asset
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: polished square promotional poster, 1:1, high resolution at least 1200 by 1200 pixels. Primary request: create an exceptionally elegant French advertising visual for Les Consultants E-learning Luxembourg highlighting five online AML 2026 courses. Art direction: contemporary premium European financial-services editorial design, strong typography, generous negative space, precise clean alignment, subtle depth and tactile paper quality. Use emerald #157a61, deep forest green #0f5e4a, warm ivory #f4f8f6 and pale mint #e6f3ef. Main headline is very large AML 2026 with beautiful high-contrast hierarchy. Smaller simple brand text at the top, not a newly invented emblem: Les Consultants, then E-learning Luxembourg. Under the headline show the exact subtitle: 5 formations AML/CFT en ligne. Present five separate, clearly legible topic tiles in a deliberate balanced arrangement, with restrained small abstract dimensional learning motifs beside them, not fake regulatory symbols. The five labels verbatim, once each: Fondamentaux AML/CFT; Board of Directors; TA & Funds; Cryptoassets; Fintech. At the bottom a refined button-shaped call to action with the exact words Découvrez les formations. Under that, small but legible, the exact URL elearning-lesconsultants.com. Every listed word must be spelled correctly and every element must fit inside a comfortable safe margin. The five topics must be equally visible, none omitted or repeated. Constraints: no additional copy, no fabricated prices or client numbers, no official accreditation claims or regulator logos, no watermark, no busy stock-photo collage, no blue or purple gradients. Produce a single finished ad visual, not a board containing several concepts.

prompts.use: Preferred revised promotional poster for Display/social; contains text, not a Search image asset
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, full visual redesign of an existing poster.
Input image 1 is the existing AML 2026 poster and is the edit target. Input image 2 is the official Les Consultants logo, a branding reference to reproduce faithfully at a modest size.
Primary request: replace the poster's entire visual design with a much cleaner, more contemporary professional French advertising poster. Preserve the business, year, five course topics, call to action and exact website. Deliver one finished square poster, high resolution, crisp typography, not a mockup.
Art direction: exceptionally polished Swiss editorial graphic design for a premium financial education brand. Flat, minimal digital design, perfectly aligned left edges and baselines, generous whitespace and precise spacing. Use a modern sans-serif grotesk similar to Inter or Helvetica throughout. Typography and proportion should carry the design. Warm white #F7FAF8 background, very dark green #102D25 typography and restrained emerald #157A61 accents. Use the supplied real logo compactly at the top, preserving its symbol and lettering rather than inventing a logo. Do not let the logo dominate the poster.
Layout: a clear reading sequence from the compact brand area to a very large, bold, beautifully kerned sans-serif headline 'AML 2026', then the smaller subtitle '5 formations AML/CFT en ligne'. Below, display the five course names as a single meticulously spaced vertical programme list, with small emerald index numbers 01 to 05, consistent text size, subtle hairline separators and plenty of breathing room. The five rows form one continuous clean typographic composition. Use at most one restrained abstract green line or corner accent to balance the whitespace. The bottom contains a flat, modest emerald call-to-action area and a clearly readable website. Comfortable 7 percent safe margins. Every element must feel intentionally designed and easy to read on a phone.
Exact course labels, once each, all equally visible: 'Fondamentaux AML/CFT', 'Board of Directors', 'TA & Funds', 'Cryptoassets', 'Fintech'. Exact CTA: 'Découvrez les formations'. Exact website: 'elearning-lesconsultants.com'. All course labels and the website must be spelled perfectly. No added copy except what is already in the supplied logo.
Constraints: no serif fonts; no 3D objects, books, laptops, coin piles or phones; no separate cards or tiles; no paper folds or paper textures; no bevels, embossing, drop shadows or shiny effects; no elaborate decorative frame; no stock-photo collage; no badges or regulator logos; no prices or invented claims; no watermark. The result should be restrained, sharp, spacious and sophisticated, with all five courses retained.
